title: WaterReminder
description: Get a clear warning when you’re carrying a water bucket in the Nether.
body:
Water Reminder is a simple client-side QoL mod that helps prevent one of the most common Nether mistakes: relying on a water bucket when it won’t work.

When you enter the Nether with a water bucket in your inventory, the mod gives you a clear warning so you can react before it turns into panic. It is lightweight, simple, and only runs on the client, making it a clean quality-of-life addition for survival players, speedrunners, and anyone who wants a small safety reminder while exploring dangerous dimensions.

No complicated settings, no extra clutter — just a useful Nether warning when you need it.
